title: wg: protocol-06 §5.1 are all directory endpoints required?
description: draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §5.1 L1020-1021: 'a JSON document with URIs for each type of endpoint'. Problem: no text says whether a provider that does not offer an endpoint (e.g. groupInfo, proxyDownload) may omit its key, or what a client does then. Interop evidence: Haven mimi-hubd omits groupInfo and proxyDownload. mimid: decision mimid-1wgh.5.75. Suggested fix: state that keys for endpoints a provider does not offer MAY be omitted and a client MUST treat an absent key as 'not supported' (as RFC 8555 §7.1.1 does for optional resources).
